rulesDirectories.description: Folders with custom rule files (.js, .cjs, .mjs), relative to this file. Loaded only in trusted workspaces.

customTagPrefixes.description: Extra custom tag prefixes, in addition to taglib prefixes and settings.

documentStructure.description: Skip (ignore) or check (validate) <!DOCTYPE>, <html>, <head>, <body> in JSP files.

ignoreMessages.description: Regular expressions; matching messages from any engine are hidden.

exclude.description: Glob patterns (relative to this file) of files not to validate.

customRules.description: Rules declared without code: a CSS selector or a regular expression.

selector.description: CSS selector matched against elements, e.g. "img:not([alt])"

pattern.description: Regular expression matched against the file text (trusted workspaces only)
